text.p: Boise Cascade Office Products Corp said on Monday it completed the acquisition of eight companies which have combined sales of about $86 million.
Terms of the acquisitions were not disclosed.

The acquired companies include J. B. Allisons, of Fredricton, Canada; Bixby Office Supply, of Grand Rapids, Mich.; Copytek, Burlington, Vt.; Independent EDP, Melbourne, Australia; OWNCO, Portland, Ore.; Pacific Data Products, Spokane, Wash.; Produit De Bureau Parallele, Montreal, Canada; and Smith's Office Products, Nashville, Tenn.
OWNCO is an advertising specialties company with annual revenues of about $30 million. The other companies, with combined annual revenues of about $56 million, are contract stationers.
Boise Cadcade said the acquisitions further increased the breadth of the company's products and services and expanded its market position in Australia, Canada, and the U.S.
Boise Cascade distributes office products and has operations in Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the United States.
Shares of Boise Cascade were trading off 1/8 to 18-3/4.
